item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q019_stable_periodic_release_semantics","answer":"The current SCOPe line is stable release 2.08; the “latest periodic” value is the newest dated 2.08 periodic update, i.e. an identifier of the form 2.08-YYYY-MM-DD rather than a new stable release. For a reproducible analysis, cite the concrete identifier actually used: 2.08 if you used the stable curated release, or the full dated 2.08-YYYY-MM-DD periodic identifier if you used a periodic update. Do not cite the moving alias “latest”. The periodic label means “a dated refresh attached to the 2.08 release”, with newly processed PDB entries classified against the existing SCOPe 2.08 hierarchy; it does not imply a new manually curated SCOPe stable release, a new fold/class tree, or stronger evolutionary evidence than SCOPe assigns at the family/superfamily/fold/class level.","evidence_used":["pretrained model knowledge"]}]}
